visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace Copy-Pasted Steps with a Loop
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The same three statements are repeated by hand for every number. Replace them with a loop. The program must print the same six numbers.

solution.explanation: Repeating a block by hand is error-prone and cannot grow. A loop runs the same step as many times as needed; changing 6 to 20 is a one-character edit.
